resources.string: Your pinned cards: tap one to open its code
Pin cards with the pushpin (📌) and they\'ll show up here
Today at %1$s. Tap to show your ticket.
It\'s today. Tap to show your ticket.
EAN-13 takes 13 digits (or 12, and the last one is worked out for you).
EAN-8 takes 8 digits (or 7, and the last one is worked out for you).
UPC-A takes 12 digits (or 11, and the last one is worked out for you).
UPC-E takes 8 digits (starting with 0 or 1) or 7.
ITF takes digits only, and an even number of them.
Code 39 allows CAPITAL letters, digits, spaces and - . $ / + %%
Codabar takes digits, with a letter from A to D at the start and the end.
Code 128 allows letters, digits and symbols, but no accents.
